description: About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies — from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups — use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to grow the GDP of the internet, and we won't stop until we've made it easy for any business anywhere to participate in the digital economy. About The Role Governments around the world are fundamentally changing how businesses report and exchange transactions. Continuous Transaction Controls (CTC) and e-invoicing mandates — now active or imminent in France, Germany, Spain, Poland, and across Latin America — require businesses to transmit structured invoice data through certified government networks in real time. For Stripe's global user base, compliant e-invoicing is rapidly becoming a prerequisite for conducting commerce, not a nice-to-have. We're building the e-invoicing infrastructure that makes this invisible for Stripe users. That means embedding compliant invoice generation, validation, and transmission directly into Stripe Billing and Invoicing — abstracting the full complexity of regional mandates and network certification behind a seamless product experience. This is a high-impact, greenfield role. You'll own Stripe's e-invoicing product end-to-end: setting the strategy, driving execution, and making Stripe the go-to solution for businesses navigating the global shift to real-time invoicing compliance. You'll work at the intersection of product, engineering, partnerships, and go-to-market — and you'll be laying the foundation for a capability that will matter to every Stripe user operating in a mandated market. What you'll do Own the e-invoicing product vision and roadmap, translating complex and evolving regulatory requirements into a coherent multi-year strategy Drive Stripe's expansion across mandated global markets (France, Germany, Spain, Poland) and into Latin America, sequencing coverage pragmatically against enforcement timelines Lead build, buy, and partner decisions — evaluating the right combination of internal investment and external capabilities to meet compliance deadlines without sacrificing long-term product quality Define and own the end-to-end user journey: from onboarding (including business identity verification) to live invoice transmission via certified networks like Peppol Work closely with the Billing, Invoicing, Tax, and Connect teams to embed e-invoicing as a native part of Stripe's financial infrastructure — not a bolted-on feature Establish quality, reliability, and activation metrics that hold every component of the e-invoicing stack accountable, and use those metrics to drive continuous improvement Partner with GTM, Sales, and Solutions Engineering to position Stripe as the leading e-invoicing solution for upmarket and enterprise customers Represent Stripe credibly with regulators, certification bodies, and industry partners as we build direct relationships with key tax authorities and networks Who you are Required 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years in a B2B fintech, payments, tax, or compliance-adjacent product domain Deep familiarity with the e-invoicing landscape — you understand CTC frameworks, structured invoice formats (Factur-X, XRechnung, PEPPOL BIS), and the regulatory dynamics driving mandates in Europe and Latin America Strong technical fluency: you can credibly partner with engineers on API design, data schemas, and network integration architecture Demonstrated ability to run a build/buy/partner analysis and translate the output into concrete roadmap decisions Experience launching products across multiple markets simultaneously, including navigating localization, regulatory compliance, and differing user needs Excellent cross-functional leadership — you get things done across Engineering, Legal, Finance, and GTM without formal authority Clear, direct communication: you can distill a complex compliance landscape into a compelling product narrative for both internal stakeholders and external audiences Nice to have Experience integrating third-party technology providers or acquisitions into a core product platform Familiarity with Stripe Billing, Invoicing, or Tax products Prior experience building toward Peppol access point certification or direct integrations with national tax authority platforms (e.g., Chorus Pro, KSeF) Exposure to B2B invoicing workflows in mid-market or enterprise contexts Why this role, why now E-invoicing is one of the most consequential shifts in global business compliance in a decade, and Stripe is early in building the infrastructure to make it effortless. You'll have the mandate, the resources, and the cross-functional backing to build something significant — and the chance to make Stripe synonymous with world-class e-invoicing. Stripe is an equal opportunity employer. We look for people with exceptional abilities, who are excited by hard problems and big opportunities. In-office expectations Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible. Pay and benefits The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is €124,800 - €187,200. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process. Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.
title: Product Manager, E-Invoicing

description: Dreaming big is in our DNA. It’s who we are as a company. It’s our culture. It’s our heritage. And more than ever, it’s our future. A future where we’re always looking forward. Always serving up new ways to meet life’s moments. A future where we keep dreaming bigger. We look for people with passion, talent, and curiosity, and provide them with the teammates, resources and opportunities to unleash their full potential. The power we create together – when we combine your strengths with ours – is unstoppable. Are you ready to join a team that dreams as big as you do? AB InBev GCC was incorporated in 2014 as a strategic partner for Anheuser-Busch InBev. The center leverages the power of data and analytics to drive growth for critical business functions such as operations, finance, people, and technology. The teams are transforming Operations through Tech and Analytics. Do You Dream Big? We Need You. Job Description Job Title: Product Manager Location: Bangalore PURPOSE OF ROLE BrewDat is ABI’s data platform, powering data products and AI solutions across all our domains – from sales and marketing to supply, finance, people, and more. We provide the data foundations, frameworks, and tools that enable teams across ABI to ingest, transform, govern, and serve data at scale - following Data Mesh and Domain-Driven Design principles. About the Role We’re looking for a Product Manager with a strong technical background to lead the Integration products of BrewDat. Your main mission is to: Build and evolve the vision, strategy, and roadmap for BrewDat’s data engineering capabilities (ingestion, transformation, and serving). Understand and prioritize user needs from data engineers, analytics engineers, ML engineers, and domain teams. Turn complex platform capabilities into clear, usable products that make data teams more productive and autonomous. Build our Integration-as-a-Service platform and guide the transition from legacy middleware to cloud-native architectures You’ll work in a cross-functional squad alongside engineers, a Delivery Manager, architects, and governance specialists, and you’ll collaborate closely with the Adoption team, who bring users’ needs to the product area. KEY TASKS AND ACCOUNTABILITIES Product Strategy & Vision Define and evolve the product vision for BrewDat's data engineering layer (ingestion, transformation, and serving). Translate company and data strategy into a clear, prioritized roadmap for your squad. Discovery & User-Centricity Deeply understand the needs of data engineers, analytics engineers, domain squads, and internal platform users. Run product discovery: interviews, usage analysis, experiments, and feedback loops with internal customers. Roadmap & Delivery Own and manage the product backlog for the Data Engineering squad. Write clear problem statements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, focusing on outcomes rather than outputs. Work in an Agile environment, participating in ceremonies and ensuring alignment between Product, Engineering, and Architecture. Measurement & Continuous Improvement Define and track product KPIs: adoption, CSAT from users, build times, time-to-data, platform reliability, etc. Use data and feedback to continuously refine priorities and validate if shipped features are creating value. Promote a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement within the squad. Stakeholder Management & Communication Align with multiple stakeholders (domains like sales, marketing, supply, finance, tech, etc.). Communicate roadmap, progress, trade-offs, and impact clearly and frequently. Partner with the Adoption team to launch new capabilities, manage change, and scale usage. Middleware Managing the consolidated middleware roadmap, prioritizing global reliability frameworks (like cross-zone replication/caching), and tracking integration unit economics (e.g., standardizing integration cost per application). QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, SKILLS: Must-Have Solid experience as a Product Manager (or Product Owner acting as PM) in: Data platforms, data engineering, analytics platforms, or developer/platform tools, or Technical products with strong infrastructure or backend components. Technical background (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Data, or equivalent experience). You don't need to code daily, but you must: Be comfortable discussing architecture, pipelines, and technical trade-offs with engineers. Understand concepts like data pipelines, ETL/ELT, orchestration, data lakes, data warehouses, and APIs. Broaden the technical scope to include API management, event-driven architectures, and microservices alongside the existing data pipeline concepts. Strong skills in: Product discovery and problem framing. Prioritization and roadmap management. Ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, negotiate priorities, and align diverse interests. Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken). Nice-to-Have (Differentials) Experience with some of the technologies and concepts we use is a big plus, but not mandatory: Cloud & Data: Azure, Databricks, Apache Spark, Airflow, Unity Catalog. Engineering Practices: GitHub, CI/CD, code review flows, Data Mesh. Experience with internal platforms or "products for developers/data teams" is especially valuable. Explicitly call out experience with legacy-to-cloud migrations (e.g., MuleSoft to Camel-K), Azure DevOps for delivery tracking, and deep observability tools like Datadog. And above all of this, an undying love for beer! We dream big to create future with more cheers
title: Product Manager

description: Come make a difference in a fast-growing, innovative, Software Product Management team that combines a scale-up atmosphere with a global industry-leading product portfolio. You'll be part of building the future of Trackunit's connected ecosystem - helping shape products that connect people, data, and machines to build a smarter construction industry. At Trackunit, we put our customers first. As a Product Manager, you'll work across teams and departments to guide software products from research and idea through to launch - connecting the customer, technical, and business worlds. You'll break down complex problems into clear, actionable steps and drive product development with focus, purpose, and measurable outcomes. This role drives Trackunit's Data Products, including the Analytics Suite and Benchmarking product. These tools sit on top of Trackunit's connected data platform and give fleet operators, operations teams, and data-driven decision-makers a way to turn machine and site data into actionable insight. Data Products are one of Trackunit's highest-leverage growth areas: the ability to surface meaningful, industry-specific analysis is what keeps customers on the platform and drives expansion. We're looking for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, brings clarity amid change, and builds strong alignment across diverse teams. If you're passionate about creating meaningful products and want to make a tangible impact in a global SaaS company - we'd love to hear from you. You will be connected to one of our offices in Denmark, Germany or the Netherlands with the possibility to work from one of the dedicated offices and remotely in a flexible capacity. What's in it for you? You'll join the Platform Pod - the team building the foundation everything else runs on. The pod's mandate is to evolve IrisX into a Platform-as-a-Service: enabling AI enabled and faster development across the ecosystem, powering data-driven value creation, and unlocking multi-sided business models at construction scale. Portals is a core pillar of that vision. A place in a hyper-growth SaaS business, with possibilities to grow internally in the company. We are moving quickly, so fasten your seat belt and prepare to adjust. Back in 2020 we were 150 employees at Trackunit and we have just passed 450 employees. International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders. We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and we support them through training, coaching and mindfulness as well as with an open feedback culture to enable you to identify your strengths and opportunities. We do this by touching upon your impact on our triple focus: impacting yourself, impacting teams/relations and impacting the organisation/strategy. Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us or something we state in a job posting. We do offer you a flexible setup and believe that you best can structure how your routines look like. And once you have chosen how you work best, let us know what you need: we got you covered with the IT equipment you need for your work. Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. And this priority starts with our hiring - we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit. Learn more about TIDE and other DE&I initiatives here. Who are you ideally? You've done product management in a B2B SaaS or platform/industrial software environment. You've built products for data-intensive user personas. You know what "good" looks like for a data analyst, BI team, or data scientist, and you understand the gap between what a data platform can technically do and what users actually adopt. You're a technical PM with genuine data stack depth (i.e. databricks), close enough to engineering to challenge scope and catch tradeoffs. You think and build AI-first. You reach for AI capabilities as a default design tool — not a bolt-on — and you know how to evaluate when AI genuinely reduces friction versus when it adds noise. You've shipped or closely partnered on AI-powered product features, and you can have a substantive conversation with engineers about what's feasible, what's not, and what's worth the bet. You bring great structuring and analytical skills with the ability to implement strategic product plans and to proactively make things happen with a hands-on attitude. You're an effective communicator who knows how to work asynchronously and across time zones. You're experienced in the full product lifecycle: from backlog refinement and sprint execution to coordinating with go-to-market teams. You're adept at navigating trade-offs, bringing cross-functional clarity, and moving work forward. You bring commercial awareness and know how to define and measure progress with data and feedback loops. You're collaborative and pragmatic. Comfortable aligning when you can, and pushing forward when you can't. You focus on delivering impact, not just output, and you own what you build. Don't meet every single requirement? No worries - this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're super excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. Primary Responsibilities Own the Data Products roadmap: Set the strategy and priorities for the Analytics Suite, Benchmarking, and the data-facing experiences built on Trackunit's connected platform. This means deciding what gets built, what gets deferred, and what gets cut, and being able to explain the reasoning to engineering, go-to-market teams, and leadership alike. Drive end-to-end product execution: Own the build process from backlog refinement to release, working closely with Engineering and Design to deliver high-quality outcomes. Lead go-to-market efforts: Coordinate with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to ensure launches are aligned, well-orchestrated, and supported by clear enablement. Create clarity across functions: Align teams on scope, trade-offs, and timelines, especially where regional context, dependencies, or ambiguity exist. Build effective async collaboration: Communicate clearly across time zones and stakeholders, using structured, proactive updates to keep momentum. Shape how we work: Contribute to evolving product practices, frameworks, and rituals, rather than just following what exists. Partner with Data Engineering on platform surface: Co-define what Trackunit's data platform exposes through APIs, dashboards, and developer tools, and how it's documented and made accessible to internal teams and external builders. Drive data product adoption: Work closely with Customer Success and key accounts to understand where data tools create real value, and close that loop back into discovery and prioritization. Our hiring process Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter. Virtual meet and greet. Meet Dr. Oliver Oechslein, Senior Director of Product Management and the hiring manager for this role. Deep Dive interview focusing on past experience, product craft, and team culture. Assignment-specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job. If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself. Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you! Coming Together To Connect Construction We're committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale. We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products – it's a way of life at Trackunit. We're proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world. The question is: Are you in?

The Role As the Product Manager you will own the full 0-1 lifecycle of AI initiatives, from problem framing and discovery through to vendor coordination, evaluation, production launch, and iteration, and use your expertise to help navigate the team to curate AI-powered features into their highly successful mobile app. The role is hands-on so you will be working closely with engineers and AI vendors, the Product Lead and senior stakeholders. description: Business Analyst Location: HSR, Bangalore The Business Analyst will own business readiness and outcome validation for the platform's key initiatives, partnering closely with client-side business teams as well as internal product, engineering, and QA functions to verify that integrations, features, tracking, and business goals are solid before anything reaches customers. This role functions as the last line of business sign-off, making sure releases hit their success bar and actually deliver the value they were built for. Key Responsibilities Business Readiness & Validation * Confirm business requirements have been built out completely and match stated goals * Trace end-to-end business workflows across platforms, partners, and integration points * Check that features behave correctly under real-world conditions, not only in test scenarios * Make sure tracking, reporting, and metrics are implemented correctly and verified before launch Client Collaboration * Partner with client-side business stakeholders to confirm integration behavior, data flow, customer journey accuracy, and adherence to business rules and policy * Act as the go-to contact for resolving issues surfaced during validation Business Outcome Measurement * Establish and validate KPIs, funnels, and success metrics * Confirm analytics genuinely reflect business performance * Run outcome checks after release against original objectives * Catch deviations quickly and push for corrective action Product & Delivery Partnership * Convert business intent into clear requirements and acceptance criteria * Collaborate with Product Managers to keep features tied to outcomes * Coordinate with Engineering and QA on complex integration and edge-case testing * Keep documentation current — BRDs, PRDs, metric definitions, and validation notes Must-Have Skills & Experience * 4–6 years working as a Business Analyst in e-commerce or high-scale B2C environments * Track record validating business readiness ahead of production releases * Solid understanding of integration-heavy systems (payments, financial institutions, partners) * Practical experience defining metrics and validating tracking * Strong stakeholder management skills with enterprise-level teams * Comfortable taking a firm, evidence-based position on release readiness Good to Have * Background in financial services or other regulated environments * Experience with rewards, payments, or marketplace platforms * Familiarity with GA, Adobe, Mixpanel, or Amplitude * Experience running phased rollouts or controlled customer exposure What Success Looks Like * Releases are business-ready, measurable, and tied to clear objectives * Client stakeholders trust the functionality and outcomes * Tracking and reporting are accurate and reliable * Business decisions rest on validated data rather than assumptions

description: Wil jij werken aan slimme, procesgedreven oplossingen met PEGA en organisaties helpen hun dienstverlening écht te verbeteren? Of heb je juist de ambitie om je te ontwikkelen tot Business Analist PEGA en wil je daarin professioneel worden opgeleid? Bij ilionx bieden we beide mogelijkheden. Jouw functie als Business Analist PEGA Als Business Analist PEGA werk je op het snijvlak van business en IT. Pega is een modern ICT-platform dat gebruikt wordt om zaakgerichte werkprocessen voor opdrachtgevers te automatiseren. Je vertaalt complexe processen en klantvragen naar heldere requirements d.m.v. interviews en realiseert samen met je team krachtige PEGA-oplossingen. Je bent betrokken bij het hele traject: van analyse en ontwerp tot implementatie en optimalisatie. Heb je al ervaring met PEGA? Dan krijg je direct verantwoordelijkheid binnen uitdagende projecten. Heb je nog geen of beperkte PEGA-ervaring, maar wel affiniteit met businessanalyse en procesautomatisering? Dan leiden wij je op via onze ilionx Academy en groei je stap voor stap in de rol. Je werkt aan projecten bij klanten waar PEGA een belangrijke rol speelt in het verbeteren van processen en digitale dienstverlening. Wat ga je doen • Analyseren en modelleren van bedrijfsprocessen • Vertalen van businesswensen naar functionele en niet-functionele requirements • Opstellen, analyseren en prioriteren van user stories • Samenwerken met developers, consultants en stakeholders • Bijdragen aan de doorontwikkeling en optimalisatie van PEGA-oplossingen • Meedenken over procesverbetering en automatisering Wat bieden wij jou? Bij ilionx krijg je de ruimte om jezelf continu te ontwikkelen. We investeren in opleidingen, certificeringen en kennissessies zodat jij zowel persoonlijk als in het vakgebied van PEGA kan groeien. Daarnaast bieden we jou: • Een aantrekkelijk salaris tussen de €3500,- en €6000,- o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring • Een ruime mobiliteitsvergoeding, netto onkostenvergoeding en een goede pensioenregeling bij a.s.r. • Direct een vast contract en een bonus die kan oplopen tot een kalendermaand • Uitdagende & innovatieve PEGA-projecten met impact • Een open en informele cultuur met collega’s die expert zijn in hun vakgebied • Regelmatige bijeenkomsten met collega’s om inzichten en ervaringen te delen • Leuke evenementen en uitjes, waaronder onze jaarlijkse ilionx wintersport Wat vragen wij van jou? • Affiniteit met IT en low-code platformen, bij voorkeur PEGA • Interesse in businessanalyse en procesoptimalisatie • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en analytisch vermogen • Bereidheid om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen Verder heb je: • Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde hbo-opleiding • Minimaal 3 jaar IT-ervaring als PEGA Consultant, Business (Informatie) Analist, functioneel ontwerper of vergelijkbaar • Behaalde PEGA-certificeringen zoals Certified Business Architect PEGA zijn een grote pré • Kennis en ervaring met het werken met Agile methodieken • Een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel in woord als geschrift Bovenstaande criteria zijn een indicatie van het profiel wat we zoeken. We beseffen dat elk individu een unieke set aan vaardigheden, expertise, skills en denkwijzen met zich meebrengt. Tegelijkertijd blijkt uit onderzoek dat sommigen pas solliciteren als er een 100% match is. Hierbij nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren als je je herkent in het profiel, óók als je niet aan alle eisen voldoet! Het Team Binnen de unit Digitale Strategie werken we dagelijks nauw samen met collega’s die net even dat stapje extra voor onze klanten in regio Noord-Nederland durven te zetten. En dat vooral met passie, gedrevenheid én enthousiasme. Jouw manager Albert Jan zorgt hierin vooral voor een prettige werkomgeving waarin hij jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling én de samenwerking met jouw collega’s juist alleen maar zal aanmoedigen. Dit doet hij op basis van onderling vertrouwen, transparantie en het motto 'afspraak is afspraak'. Lees hier praktijkervaringen van jouw toekomstige ilionx collega’s!
title: Business Analist PEGA
